messages:
sara: quick heads-up, ran a perf sweep on MQA + paged-KV layouts on h100. seeing a ~18% throughput drop vs last week when seqlen distribution shifts to a lot of mid-length (64-192). not a pure kernel bug but kernel selector picks different path that does a KV-copy more often.
kevin: can you paste the bench numbers? and which kernel paths were picked?
sara: baseline (old pick): grouped_attn_pagedkv_v2, tokens/s=28.5k, p99=42ms. new pick (autotuner): hybrid_prefetch_kvstripe, tokens/s=23.4k, p99=58ms. seqlen mix used: 10%<32, 65% 64-192, 25% >512.
raj: hmm that drop maps to extra memcpy + reformat when kvstripe layout is selected. did you profile GPU memcpy time?
sara: yes attached a short nvtx slice: memcpy 12ms per batch increase vs baseline. kernel execution unchanged. also saw increased L2 traffic.
olga: @sara can you share the selector score calc? iirc we recently changed to favor memory-stable kernels on A100 but that might be mis-weighted on H100.
sara: selector score currently: score = latency_est * 0.6 + mem_penalty * 0.4. mem_penalty is estimated bytes_moved / 1e6. config snippet: ```json
{"selector": {"weights": {"latency": 0.6, "mem": 0.4}, "hysteresis_ms": 8}}
```
kevin: that hysteresis_ms of 8 might be too high causing late flips when the incoming seqlen distribution drifts. we should add seqlen-aware smoothing (exponential decay over buckets).
raj: idea: augment score with cache_affinity term to prefer kernel that reuses existing KV layout to avoid copies. new score: score = a*lat + b*mem + c*(1-cache_affinity). where cache_affinity \\in [0,1].
olga: agree. also for MQA grouped qkv we've observed blocksize sensitivity: blocksz=128 works best for short mid seqs, 256 for long. autotuner should pick blocksz per route, not global.
sara: ran quick opt: forcing grouped_attn_pagedkv_v2 with blocksz=128 recovered tokens/s to 27.8k. p99 back to 44ms. so definitely a selector + block size issue.
bench-bot: /bench run --profile --config selector_explore_1967500000.yaml --concurrency 16 --batching bucketed
bench-bot: results (summary): selector_explore: grouped_attn_pagedkv_v2@128 -> 27.8k t/s, hybrid_prefetch_kvstripe@256 -> 23.2k t/s, fallback-replicated@64 -> 21.5k t/s.
kevin: good repro. next steps: 1) tweak selector weights for H100 profile (lower mem penalty weight), 2) add blocksz per-kernel tag in model manifest, 3) implement cache_affinity term and a decay window for seqlen stats.
raj: for 3) propose we use an EWMA over recent N requests per route per model: bucketed by seqlen class (0-32,33-128,129-512,>512). affinity = fraction of requests that keep same kv-layout * exp(-age/tau). tau default 30s.
olga: small caution: affinity calc must be cross-instance safe for Dedicated pools; use tag in plan so autoscaler doesn't evict layout-sensitive replicas.
sara: i'm going to prototype selector change in a branch, will add a dashboard of selector picks + bytes_moved per minute. logging: add fields selector_pick, estimated_bytes_moved, block_size.
kevin: also add unit/regression test: synthetic seqlen stream that ramps mid-lengths to ensure selector doesn't flip to mem-heavy kernels.
raj: filing a tiny perf task: PERF-1423 "selector: seqlen-aware affinity + per-kernel blocksz tuning". assign to sara + kevin.
sara: assigning and starting work. will post bench logs here once prototype is up. :raised_hands:
kevin: thanks, ping me when the branch is ready, i'll run big fleet sweep across A100/H100. :thumbsup:
